days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hola, Rival Sol, voy con prisa: 66 por Plaza del Dos de Mayo y cerramos ya. Entrega inmediata.
Happy to sell Plaza del Dos de Mayo at 116 with 10 delivery days, a fair deal we can sign today.
Thanks for moving. I can come down to 98 with delivery in 4 days, a fair middle ground.
Venga, 84; no tengo mucho tiempo. Entrega inmediata.
Immediate delivery as you want: 100 with 0 days and we close.
92 y lo cerramos ahora. Entrega inmediata.
I can do 90 P with delivery in 0 days to close today.
